stage1.impression: A good-looking architectural visualisation of a warm timber-and-concrete bar, but it reads as CG, not a photograph. The brightest large surface is the plain right-hand concrete wall with its blank pale frames and stray light patches, not the speakers. The floor carries flat black polygon shadows that look like decals. The blurred figures are pink, translucent ghosts that look composited. The altar pair reads as two small white monitors, and the Smoke tint barely registers. The black slotted globe is the one specific, memorable gesture; otherwise a magazine would see a generic, well-dressed bar render rather than a specific place.

blocking_9: The right-hand concrete wall and its frames must stop being the brightest large area: wall region lum_median below about 70, with the altar pair and the counter as the brightest things in the frame
The altar speakers must read as tinted Smoke acrylic objects with glowing edges, not white boxes: no clipped white batts (clip_pct under 0.5 in their regions) and a visible smoked tint
No hard-edged black polygon shadows on the floor; floor shadows soft and from a source you can identify
Blurred people must read as opaque motion blur on solid bodies (dark clothing, a sharp still part such as a seated torso or hands on the bar), not pink translucent ghosts; fewer at the counter
Stray light patches on the right wall must belong to one motivated source (Mother EARF's shadow), not read as daylight through a window at night
Concrete and floor need more real texture at 1:1 (tie holes, board marks, pour lines) and less smooth grey; repeated identical stools need variation or partial occlusion
To read as a specific place, not a generic bar: the altar and Mother EARF must carry the frame (light pooled at the far end, the globe's shadow as a deliberate graphic on the wall)

defects.what: Right concrete wall and big pale frames are the brightest large area (median 97, frame panel 117); the screens read as blank grey boards
Hard pale light patches on the wall read as moonlight or daylight through a window, not as the globe's spot shadow
Flat, hard-edged black triangular shadows on the floor that look like decals; source unclear
Floor too bright and smooth for a night room (median 75); polished stone pattern reads as tiled texture
Altar speakers read as small white boxes with clipped batts (clip 1.7 % on the left one); no Smoke tint, no edge glow; too small to be the hero
Counter figures are pink, semi-transparent ghosts with doubled heads; they look composited, not exposed
Banquette figures dissolve into the upholstery as grey smears
Identical counter stools repeated in a row, all equally lit; reads as one model copied
Orb lamps read as flat white discs (ping-pong balls), with no visible smoked shell or frosted liner
Mother EARF is legible as a silhouette but has no edge highlights on the 25 mm discs; reads as a wire cage rather than cast acrylic
Overall grade a little bright and milky for night (frame median 51, at the top of the band); slight noise and sepia cast

changes.problem: The right-hand concrete wall and its frames outshine the speakers and the counter, so the eye goes to an empty wall.

evidence.measured: lum_median 97.1, frame panel [1070,0,1200,420] median 117.2, against 44.5 to 49.5 on the altar speakers

change.setting: the screens' images emission and Mother EARF hard spot
change.from: screens 0.05; Mother EARF spot 140.0 W, cone 30.0 deg
change.to: screens 0.02; Mother EARF spot 60 W, cone 18 deg, aimed so the globe's shadow alone lands on the wall

changes.expected: The wall drops into a mid-dark, with one tight pool and the globe's shadow as the only graphic on it; the eye goes back down the room

changes.problem: The altar pair is the hero but reads as small white boxes with clipped batts and no tint.

evidence.measured: lum_median 44.5, lum_p95 243.9, clip_pct 1.68; right speaker [650,330,700,440] clip 0.38, r/g/b medians 60/47/38 (no smoke tint)

change.setting: the altar's spots and the lamps on the speakers
change.from: altar 2 x spot 380.0 W, cone 24.0 deg; on each speaker 4 x area 1.0 W/m2
change.to: altar 2 x spot 200 W, cone 34 deg, aimed at the cabinet sides and top edge rather than the batts; on each speaker area lamps 3.0 W/m2 grazing from the sides so the acrylic edges glow

changes.expected: The cabinets read as smoked acrylic volumes with glowing edges; the batts no longer clip; the far end becomes the brightest pool in the room

changes.problem: The floor is too bright and carries hard black polygon shadows that read as decals.

evidence.measured: lum_median 75.0, p95 179; crop shows flat black triangles with razor edges

change.setting: the Domes' downlights and the floor's polish
change.from: 4 x spot 20.0 W, cone 20.0 deg; floor polish as is
change.to: 4 x spot 12 W, cone 28 deg with a 0.05 m soft radius; floor roughness up about 0.15 so it holds dim, soft reflections; find and soften or remove whatever source throws the triangle shadows (likely the screens or the globe spot through the slots)

changes.expected: The floor drops to a dim warm grey with soft-edged shadows; light pools on the counter and the tables rather than the floor

changes.problem: The people read as pink, translucent composited ghosts, especially at the counter.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: doubled heads, skin-pink smears with the record wall visible through torsos

change.from: 3 at the counter, shutter 1.0 frame, head travel [0.2, 0.12, 0.03] m, turn 35 deg
change.to: 2 at the counter (one still, one turning), shutter 0.5 frame, head travel [0.08, 0.05, 0.01] m, turn 15 deg; dress them in dark clothing so bodies stay opaque and only hands and heads smear

changes.expected: Figures read as real people moving during a long exposure: solid bodies, soft faces, no see-through torsos

changes.problem: The grade is milky and bright for a night room.

evidence.measured: frame lum_median 50.8 (top of the 22 to 50 band), lum_p5 10.7, sepia r/g/b 73/46/31

change.to: exposure 4.2, white_balance_k 2850, keeping AgX Medium High Contrast

changes.expected: A lower-key frame where the practicals carry the light and the shadows still hold detail

changes.problem: Mother EARF reads as a black wire cage, not 25 mm cast smoked acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 16.9, p95 52.1; no edge highlights on the discs

change.from: unlit, one hard spot 140 W from above
change.to: add a small, tight rim from the record-wall side (or let one Dome downlight graze it) so the polished disc edges catch thin bright lines; keep the discs unlit

changes.expected: Disc edges show glowing polished lines, reading as thick acrylic; the globe becomes the centrepiece rather than a silhouette

changes.problem: The Orbs read as flat white discs with no smoked shell visible.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: uniform white faces, no tint or liner depth

changes.expected: The liner glows softly inside a visible smoked shell, and the tables keep their pools

changes.problem: The row of identical counter stools reads as one model copied, all equally lit.

evidence.measured: five identical stools at identical angles

change.from: all stools square to the counter
change.to: turn two stools 10 to 25 degrees, pull one out, put the coat and a bag on another, keep the lit stool tops in the front two only

changes.expected: A used, lived-in counter instead of a showroom row

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar pair larger in frame or bring the camera closer to the altar
out_of_scope.why: Camera moves are allowed, but this frame is fixed as the view from the door; a tighter lens or a further step in would help the hero read, but it changes the frame's purpose, so the owner decides

out_of_scope.request: Give the speakers a stronger tint so they carry the frame's only colour
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour is fixed by the Smoke configuration

out_of_scope.request: Replace the blank pale wall panels with darker or more legible images
out_of_scope.why: The screens and what they show are fixed by the room's design; only their brightness may change (see c1)
